missing.why: Verse 22 gives Assir as Korah's son and verse 23 then gives Elkanah 'his son', so Assir begat Elkanah.
Verse 34 reads 'the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah', so Eliel begat Jeroham.
Verse 36 reads 'the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah', so Joel begat Elkanah, the father of Amasai and Ahimoth named in verse 25.
Verse 39 says 'And his brother Asaph', his being Heman the singer of verse 33.

note: Variant kept: jeroham son-of elihu (verse 27 names Eliab and verse 34 names Eliel; 1SA 1:1 gives Elihu), and verse 34 is recorded as a missing row above. Owner rows that look wrong: amasai son-of elkanah (105603) and ahimoth son-of elkanah (105596) point at the verse 23 Elkanah while verses 25 and 36 make the verse 25 Elkanah the son of Joel (elkanah-4), elkanah-4 son-of mahath (107213) contradicts verse 35 where the son of Mahath is elkanah-5, and zimmah son-of shimei-8 (107185), zerah-4 son-of adaiah-2 (107161) and ethni son-of zerah-4 (106817) merge namesakes from verses 20-21 and 41-42; kish-5, amaziah-4, asaiah-5 and uriel-2 duplicate kishi, amaziah-the-merarite, asaiah-3 and uriel.
